messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: [PAGE] text-gen-p99-latency us-west-2 > 2.5s (5m window). paging #oncall
Maya C: ack — I'm primary for this shift. seeing p99 ~2.6-3.2s across text-gen-api, some clients reporting timeouts. no recent deploys showing in gitlab.
Maya C: quick summary: spike started ~15:10 UTC, throughput steady, error rate low but tail latency causing user visible timeouts. kvcache.evictions trending up on a subset of hosts.
Maya C: immediate actions I'm taking: 1) scale text-gen-uswest2 pool +2 nodes (requested via autoscaler), 2) reduce batch sizes (BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512) on hot routes, 3) disable prefetch for /v1/generate temporarily. applying changes now.
Kevin O: I'm secondary and standing by. will watch dashboards and customer pings. if p99 > 3.0s for >10m I'll escalate to Dan.
Lia G: I'll draft a short customer-facing note to post on the status page if we hit timeouts. flagging customers with >5% error rate.
Maya C: pulling logs from gpu-34, seeing repeated kvcache evict warnings — rotating a restart on that host to clear state.
Maya C: log snippet:
```
2026-03-10T15:12:45Z [warn] kvcache.evictions=134 host=gpu-34 load=0.68
2026-03-10T15:12:59Z [error] request=abc123 latency=2.9s model=redwood-v1
```
Maya C: scaling update: autoscaler spawned nodes gpu-58 and gpu-59, join to pool in progress. observed p99 dip to ~2.1s for one interval after nodes joined.
incident-bot: UPDATE: autoscaler complete for text-gen-uswest2 (+2 nodes).
Kevin O: p99 creeping back to 2.4s now. I'm going to enable route fallback to model-quantized-1 (lower mem footprint) for traffic above 50% concurrency. Lia — be aware this may slightly reduce sample output quality.
Maya C: enabling fallback policy now: route -> model-quantized-1 (temp) — monitoring quality metrics and error rate.
Maya C: current state 15:38 UTC: p99 2.3s, errors 0.6%, kvcache evictions trending down. no customer-facing timeouts at this moment.
Dan P: if p99 stabilizes <2.5s and no regressions by 16:00 UTC, Kevin can take primary for the next shift. otherwise I'll join the bridge.
Lia G: customer draft: "We are investigating elevated latency affecting text generation in us-west-2. Engineers are scaling capacity and routing to fallbacks. No widespread timeouts at this time. We'll update within 20 minutes or sooner." will post if we see timeouts.
Maya C: outstanding items for handoff:
- Keep watching p99 for the next 30m (alerts configured at 2.5s / 3.0s).
- Verify fallback model doesn't increase error rate >1% or lead to regressions in critical evals.
- Confirm no new deploys; if deploy found, rollback and re-evaluate.
- If mempressure returns, run kvcache flush on low-traffic hosts (runbook: https://runbook.internal/kvcache-evict).
Kevin O: I can take over as primary at 16:10 UTC and cover until 17:40 UTC. escalation chain: Dan P -> SRE Lead (pager) if p99 > 3.0s or errors >2%.
incident-bot: REMINDER: create an on-call handoff note with tag "handoff" before closing this thread: /create-note
Maya C: leaving bridge: https://zoom.redwood/b/12345 — handing off to Kevin in ~5m. I'll post any last observations before I go.
Kevin O: ack. I'll post a status update at 16:20 UTC after monitoring for 10m. Lia — thanks, will notify if fallback quality looks problematic. :thumbsup:
Lia G: ack — standing by for customer updates.
Maya C: final note before handoff: latest checks show no deploys, autoscaler healthy, fallback in place. watch for kvcache.evictions > 100/min as the primary early warning.
Kevin O: taking primary now (16:10 UTC). signing off from thread for handoff process to avoid noise.
